title: The Resistance Circuit
description: Travel across the three settlement clusters — Bungale, Vitengeni, and Kaya Fungo — to unite the elders and mobilize 100% community support.

objectives.description: Rally the Bungale farmers cluster against forced plantation labor (+35% Support).
Secure the Vitengeni elders cluster to reject colonial poll taxes (+35% Support).
Convene with the Kaya Fungo delegates at the sacred threshold (+30% Support).

reward_text: Community Support has reached 100%! The Kifudu Gathering commences at Kaya Fungo.
